items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Like Prez, don’t you know the words or something?

ctx.x: Don’t you know the words? Don’t you know the words or anything? Like Prez, don’t you know the words or something? Well hum some of the words, man.

items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lester Young‟s manager after a while.

ctx.x: Yeah, a strong player. He‟d twirl his bass and he… good playing. The thing that impressed me… I was too shy to say anything to him. I would wait for him to… I‟d go in to see the theater… Charlie Carpenter who was…
Lester Young‟s manager after a while.
Yeah. We was in Boy Scouts together, Troop 533, Ebenezer Baptist Church. He was on the door at the Regal so I could go in and out of there at the time we were Boy Scouts.
